message: 敵

name: Helena
message: 「Aaaalright, everyone, quiet down, quiet down!」
Supported by Riesling, Melilot sat down in a chair and began to speak.

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel hasn't disappeared.」
Lines like "Is your body feeling better now?" completely flew out of my head.

name: Synn
message: 「Where is she?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「She is inside an isolated space.」

name: Ria
message: 「An isolated space?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Picture this world as a gigantic bag.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you pinch the surface of the bag and tie a rubber band around the base of the pinched section...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It creates a small pocket. Think of an isolated space as something like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean Azel is inside that?」
Melilot gave a small nod.

name: Melilot
message: 「Traces of space being forcibly twisted out of shape were left behind.」

name: Synn
message: 「How can we rescue her from there?! Please tell me!」

name: Misa
message: 「C-Calm down, Sakura-kun!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Um.」

name: Ria
message: 「I know you want to save her as soon as possible, but acting without even knowing the identity of whoever trapped Azel-chan is dangerous.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're... right. Sorry.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So the big bad mastermind is finally making an appearance! The lesboss!」

name: Misa
message: 「L-Lesboss?! H-How scandalous!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You mean 'last boss.'」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Um.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When ya say mastermind... ya mean that Bylous bastard?!」

name: Synn
message: 「So he's the one...」

name: Ria
message: 「Bylous said he was looking forward to the day of Re-Crea, didn't he?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... I think they're trying to do something using Azel.」

name: Misa
message: 「A hostage! That makes it even more unforgivable!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Um!」
Our gazes gathered toward the sudden voice.
The owner of the voice was Lolotte's friend, Amyrina.

name: Amyrina
message: 「U-um, well... I don't even know why the Chairwoman called me here, so... is it really okay for an outsider like me to speak up?」

name: Helena
message: 「You're more than welcome to.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Um... I don't know how much power this Bylous person has, but... I'm not sure about that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you talking about? They're the big boss of evil, so it wouldn't be surprising at all.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「B-but... they said in class that only God, or something equivalent to God, can remake the world...」

name: Synn
message: 「Did we ever have a class like that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Beats me?」

name: Misa
message: 「Could it be! D-did I, of all people, doze off during class!?」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think that was at our school.\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's news to me. They didn't teach that in the classes I took either. It must be an elective.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Come on! We were taking the exact same class!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's fine. I just learned it from Amyrina right now.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「*Sigh*... Even though it's the most basic of basics...」
Oh, right.
Lolotte is an angel, and Amyrina is an angel too. It must be a class the angels took.

name: Helena
message: 「That's right. Just as Amyrina-chan says, no matter how strong Bylous is, that would be impossible.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then who took Azel!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If even a guy like Bylous can't pull it off... does that mean it's one of the Seven Demon Generals?」

name: Misa
message: 「Eauderourke-san, Pasta-san, Arden, Sengen'in-sensei, Bylous... there are still two more, right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Melphas-san is one too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Melphas-san?」

name: Synn
message: 「That weird guy who was hitting on everyone at KiraFes.」

name: Misa
message: 「That pervert is a Demon General!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really can't judge a book by its cover. Not that I've ever met him.」

name: Ria
message: 「That leaves just one, then.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「B-But even those demons aren't anywhere near on par with a god.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Couldn't the last one be stronger than Bylous? Or maybe Bylous and whoever's left teamed up.」

name: Helena
message: 「That's not it.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Melilot. Forgive me if it is presumptuous, but shall I explain things to everyone?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Thank you, Riesling, but I will do it.」
Melilot raised her head, looked around at us, and spoke.

name: Melilot
message: 「The one who sealed Azel away is none other than Azel herself.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Whaaat.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's impossible!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「B-But at the very least, someone like Bylous shouldn't have been able to do it either.」

name: Melilot
message: 「For Azel, it is possible.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-W-Wait a second! Does that mean Azel is actually stronger than Bylous?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right.」

name: Melilot
message: 「As she is now, Azel possesses power rivaling that of a god.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel... a god?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「N-No way! Azel is a far more capable angel than the rest of us, sure, but she's no god.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um... I'm not really following what you mean...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Last night, you all saw that raging power centered around Azel, did you not?」

name: Synn
message: 「We saw it, yeah, but...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Only a being on par with a god could trigger a phenomenon of that magnitude.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That was quite the spectacle.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Calling that a spectacle makes you one gutsy chick.」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, if we're talking about that, the magic Melilot-san unleashed back then was amazing too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「More importantly, who even is Melilot-san?」

name: Helena
message: 「She's one of the Seven Demon Generals, after all. The strongest magic user. When people talk about witches in the Demon World, they mean her.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that right? Makes sense.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, whaaaat!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then the reason Helena-san knew so much about magic was.」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right.」

name: Ria
message: 「Since she's Big Sis's friend... I figured she wasn't a normal person, but...」

name: Melilot
message: 「That spell was the strongest magic I am capable of wielding.」

name: Helena
message: 「Long ago, when angels and demons fought in the Human World, it was a forbidden curse sealed away for being far too powerful.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Now I remember. That's the stuff passed down in human legends as 'Indra's Arrow,' 'Sodom and Gomorrah,' and 'Atlantis,' right?」

name: Helena
message: 「In theory, it could even obliterate a Bylous, couldn't it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I could only aim it roughly, and the precision of the sigils was low, so I believe that would have been impossible.」

name: Helena
message: 「That was our trump card, though. All the searchlights overloaded and fried, so it'll take two months to repair them. Good grief.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if they are repaired, I expended nearly all the magical power stored within my body, so it will be impossible for half a year.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You fired something like that at Azel!?」

name: Helena
message: 「It didn't even put a single scratch on Azel-chan, did it?」
Silence fell over the Student Council room.

name: Synn
message: 「Why... does Azel have that kind of power...」

name: Synn
message: 「Is Azel... a god?」
Back at the church, Azel once said that there was no god here.
I wondered why she'd say something like that, but if she's a god herself...

name: Melilot
message: 「...She is.」
Melilot-san hesitated.

name: Synn
message: 「Please tell me.」

name: Melilot
message: 「She is... At the very least, the power dwelling within her is...」
Melilot looked straight into my eyes and told me.

name: Melilot
message: 「Re-Crea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Re-Crea?」

name: Ria
message: 「Azel-chan is...? What do you mean...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is no other explanation for generating that much power besides Re-Crea.」

name: Helena
message: 「In other words, the will and power of Re-Crea reside inside Azel-chan.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um... Re-Crea is just when space warps or something and demons show up, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's not all it is. This Re-Crea is going to destroy the world.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's going to destroy the world?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, I see, the world's gonna end.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Whaaat?!」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Hey, Sis, why are you saying that so casually?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Because it's the truth.」

name: Melilot
message: 「At this rate, the world will be destroyed by midnight on December 24th, three days from now at the latest.」

name: Misa
message: 「What do you mean the world will be destroyed?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Just what it sounds like. Apparently Heaven, the Demon World, and the Human World will all collapse.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait a second! If Azel is Re-Crea, that means Azel is going to destroy this world?! That's impossible!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Unfortunately, I cannot say it is impossible.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Examples of strong faith driving people to acts beyond ordinary human capability are too numerous to count. In fact, I have seen many such people myself.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I hear that in Heaven, Re-Crea is taught as an act of re-creation of the world by God.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-Yes. Officially, that is the case, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nobody believes in that kind of superstition nowadays.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Th-That's not true! Besides, theology exams are mandatory, and in fact, the investigation is--a-awawa!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Investigation?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That Re-Crea is the manifestation of God's will to destroy this imperfect world divided into three--Heaven, the Demon World, and the Human World--and recreate it into a perfect world.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes... that's right, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「God's will...」
Back when we first met, Azel was unusually fixated on God.

name: Ria
message: 「A perfect world... What kind of world would that be?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To put it bluntly, a world with only angels. I think that's how we were taught. Just imagining it sounds boring.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If it's full of guys like you, it'd be noisy, sure, but sounds pretty fun to me.」

name: Synn
message: 「What happens to humans and demons?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Apparently, everything other than angels gets wiped out in a flash.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's awful!」

name: Ria
message: 「But... why would only the angels survive?」

name: Helena
message: 「In religion, boasting that only those who follow the teachings will survive to tickle their sense of being the chosen ones is a classic move.」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis... Saying she's \{a puff|\s12\s12} is going too far.\s02」

name: Melilot
message: 「In reality, everything will perish.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Huh... But... according to the teachings...」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is no way Heaven alone could remain unscathed if the Demon World and the Human World collapse.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「When you put it that way... B-But, no way...」

name: Melilot
message: 「During a previous Re-Crea, my ancestors made contact with researchers from Heaven, exchanged data, and reached that conclusion.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heaven's leadership knows this as well. That is precisely why they dispatched an investigation team this time too.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「H-How does a demon like you know about the investigation team?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Through research and deduction. And Azel was a member of that investigation team. Isn't that right?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-Yes... that's right.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Those who join the investigation team are the elite among angels. And one of the selection criteria was supposed to be steadfast faith.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you trying to say Azel is going to destroy the world according to God's will!?」
I found myself shouting without thinking.
Still, it was true that at first, Azel had been terribly cold toward both the demons and us.

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san believes. Or rather, she believed.」
Melilot-san looked at me.

name: Melilot
message: 「That Re-Crea is the will of God.」
Azel had said this world was worthless.

name: Melilot
message: 「'I believe in the word of the Lord. All who are devout do. Even those who are not devout ought to as well.'」
She had said everything was meaningless.

name: Melilot
message: 「'The Lord is always right. Righteousness is with the Lord. Nowhere else.'」
She had also said the only book needed in the world was the one containing the word of God.

name: Melilot
message: 「'Only the Lord is right. Everything ought to be just as the Lord wills it.'」

name: Melilot
message: 「All of those are things Azel-san said right in front of me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa... amazing. Those are answers that could get a perfect score in theology.」
But even so. Even so!

name: Melilot
message: 「I asked her, 'Does that mean Azel-san's heart ought to be one with God's will?'」
Azel destroying the world, of all things.

name: Melilot
message: 「When I did, the answer came back that it was so. That her own heart was one with God's righteousness.」
It suddenly came back to me.
How Melphas once described Azel: 'She didn't look like someone who would destroy the world at all--she was a fragile, fleeting girl who looked like she might break if touched.'
Someone who would destroy the world? Azel? Ridiculous!
Those weren't even words worth remembering!
As if venting an inexplicable frustration,

name: Synn
message: 「So what if she did! What does it matter if she believed in God! There are plenty of people like that among humans too, aren't there!」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, dear, but none of those people possessed the power to destroy the world.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so! Just because she had the power doesn't mean she's going to destroy it, right? Do you even have proof that Azel is trying to destroy the world!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan, haven't you ever wondered why Pasta-chan and the others are wandering around the academy?」

name: Synn
message: 「I have, but... does that have something to do with Azel...?」
I'd gotten so caught up in being busy that I forgot. Even though there were things I'd wondered about.

name: Ria
message: 「You figured it out?」

name: Helena
message: 「The reason the demons were loitering around the academy was to create a massive magic circle designed by Soltia.」
Riesling-san pinned a map onto the whiteboard.

name: Helena
message: 「Magic circles were placed at the spots marked with red dots.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When did they do that?!」

name: Helena
message: 「They have an invisibility spell cast on them, so ordinary people can't see them. Neither can I.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Drawing a prank doodle this huge... They sure have a lot of free time.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I-It's probably not because they have free time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Making graffiti invisible so nobody sees it--what a bunch of chickens.」

name: Misa
message: 「Is that really the issue?」
I saw this circular shape cutting out Ryuusei Town very recently.

name: Nanaka
message: 「There are so many in Ryuusei Town too... Whoa. Even at Asukai Shrine!」

name: Misa
message: 「If Shio finds out, she'll go ballistic.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I've seen this shape somewhere...」
It overlapped completely with Azel's range of movement that we'd deduced from the photos.

name: Ria
message: 「This circle... No way...」
I suddenly remember when Nanaka and I tailed Azel all the way to Asukai Shrine.
Azel kept stopping over and over, checking something.
Could those have been the magic circles?

name: Melilot
message: 「As you can see, a single giant magic circle is formed by a collection of multiple magic circles.」

name: Melilot
message: 「In particular, powerful magic circles are placed at the intersections of lines and at magically significant points.」

name: Misa
message: 「Even in the plaza beneath Finis Tower...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To think something like this was right at the dance party venue!」
The photos Azel took of the cat-type demons.
The photo of pasta taken in the middle of the night.
Sengen'in-sensei--Soltia--who unexpectedly came for a home visit on the day we moved in.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey! Don't tell me that when you put this whole thing together, it's got the function of amplifying the distortion caused by Re-Crea.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is correct. It accelerates the world's Pre-Materialize--in other words, its collapse.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I saw a smaller-scale version of this a long time ago. Jeez, why is it always the worthless crap that advances?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Why did you let something this dangerous be completed!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because if we didn't let them make it, we wouldn't have known the other side's exact intentions. Besides, I was confident I could destroy anything Soltia designed.」
Aside from us, Azel was the only one who had contact with the cat-type demon making the magic circle.

name: Ria
message: 「Then you destroyed it, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Not yet.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Why not!? There are only three days left until the Holy Night Festival!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because an angel's seal was placed on the magic circle. Unless this seal is undone, the magic circle cannot be destroyed.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Most demons cannot even see this seal.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Soltia and I can sense it if we concentrate, however... undoing it will take a considerable amount of time.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「B-But why? An angel's seal on a magic circle made by a demon...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed. Only an angel should be able to create an angel's seal.」

name: Everyone
message: 「No way!」
So that's why they were walking around the academy late at night--to place the seals...
That's why they went to Asukai Shrine, stopped here and there along the way, and made contact with Pasta and the cat-type demons...

name: Melilot
message: 「In order to undo the seal promptly, we require the cooperation of you angels.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Hyaah! I-I'm not an angel...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Is it... too late for that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're such a klutz, Amyrina. I have never once let it slip that I am an angel. Ahem.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She finally came out with it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Darn it, I'm a klutz too!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Even so, none of you seem surprised...」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, well, about that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone, why are you all looking at me!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Isn't it obvious?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「That makes sense.」
Nobody says it out loud. Maybe they're trying to spare my feelings.
Because everyone is so kind.
Still, they must have figured it out by now.
That Azel is the angel who placed the seal on the angel.
And that out of religious devotion, she may have actively contributed to the world's destruction.

name: Ria
message: 「If we undo it, the world won't be destroyed, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「It'll buy us enough time for the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No problem there, then.」

name: Helena
message: 「Yeah. Though once the Holy Night Festival ends, the world will still be destroyed.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not a fundamental solution at all!」

name: Helena
message: 「I did look into a fundamental solution, though......」
Helena-san's silence carried an ominous air.

name: Ria
message: 「There is one, right, Sis!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, well...... there is a way.」

name: Misa
message: 「Then please tell us! No matter how difficult it is, if it can avert the world's destruction.」

name: Misa
message: 「We'll do it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! Leave it to us!」
I was the one who should have said Misa's words. I knew that.
Yet I couldn't speak...... It felt as though my mouth had frozen shut.

name: Helena
message: 「Well, it's......」

name: Melilot
message: 「Allow me to expl--」
Riesling-san quietly opened her mouth.

name: Riesling
message: 「If we eliminate Lady Azel along with Re-Crea, the world can be saved, you see.」
Perhaps the reason everyone fell silent was because, somewhere in our hearts, we all already knew.

name: Helena
message: 「Tamiko-chan! That's something I should be sayin--」

name: Riesling
message: 「Because I am the only one accustomed to this sort of thing.」
Having said that to Helena-san, Riesling-san formed a slightly lonely smile at the corner of his mouth.

name: Helena
message: 「Tamiko-chan...」
Riesling-san looked around at us and declared clearly, word by word.

name: Riesling
message: 「To eliminate Azel-sama. This is the surest way to save the world.」
The Student Council room froze.

name: Riesling
message: 「I understand this is a cruel reality for kind-hearted people such as yourselves, yet now that things have come to this, it is clear that Azel-sama is our enemy.」

name: Misa
message: 「Azel-san is... an enemy.」
Azel is an enemy.
I had already realized it, yet I didn't want to accept it.

name: Lolotte
message: 「J-Jiiya, isn't there a slightly gentler way to put it?」

name: Riesling
message: 「...My lady.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! Like writing 'enemy' and reading it as 'friend'!」

name: Riesling
message: 「If one does not recognize an enemy as an enemy, one cannot survive on the battlefield.」

name: Ria
message: 「That might be true, but...」

name: Riesling
message: 「We ought to set personal feelings aside and examine her actions.」
Riesling-san's voice was like chilled steel.

name: Riesling
message: 「Not only did she actively participate in constructing the magic circle, she also infiltrated the Student Council to probe into our internal affairs.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, that was more like Synn talked her into it.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Furthermore, she grew close to Synn-sama, the Demon Lord, and Melilot, and even cooperated with Soltia to lure Synn-sama out and do away with him, did she not?」

name: Ria
message: 「No way... that was.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Your eyes are clouded precisely because you have become so deeply involved with her.」

name: Riesling
message: 「If you consider all of her actions as acts intended to destroy this world, does everything not fall into place?」

name: Synn
message: 「But! Azel was the one who warned me that Soltia was going to attack!」

name: Riesling
message: 「It was Azel-sama who led you to the park.」

name: Synn
message: 「...B-But, couldn't it have just been a coincidence?!」

name: Riesling
message: 「You mean to say that she happened to go for a walk, happened to head toward the park, and at that exact time, the enemy happened to be in that very park?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well...」

name: Riesling
message: 「We have proof that Lady Azel and Soltia were connected.」
Riesling-san took out a single photograph.
In it, Soltia was pictured smiling innocently for some reason.

name: Misa
message: 「Is this Sengen'in-sensei...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is one of the photos Azel-san picked up from the photo shop right before she disappeared. It was left behind with other photos in the room she was using.」

name: Helena
message: 「Judging by the background, it was the middle of the night. That means they were close enough to take photos of each other's private expressions. Understand?」
I couldn't accept it, yet I couldn't argue back either.

name: Helena
message: 「I know this weighs heavily on everyone, but this is reality.」

name: Helena
message: 「If we can eliminate her along with Re-Crea, this world will be saved.」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sis! 'Eliminate' her, that's... Even if you suddenly tell us to fight Azel-chan...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「True, we were told to save the world from the very beginning, but something like this...」

name: Riesling
message: 「You hesitate because you think of it as 'the world.' Perhaps it would be better to think of it as saving Ryuusei Town, Ryuusei Academy, and furthermore, the people close to you.」
Weighing Azel alone against the entire world.
If we eliminate Azel, the world is saved; if we fail to eliminate Azel, the world perishes.
Logically, I understand.
But...

name: Helena
message: 「Well, the 'saving' part is easier said than done, though.」

name: Helena
message: 「As long as she stays holed up in that space, we can't attack her from our side.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The same goes for her.」

name: Helena
message: 「Meaning... she'll have to come out of her burrow in order to interfere with our world?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Precisely. Even for Re-Crea, for roughly one second immediately after opening the space, the phase is unstable.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Which means if we seize that opportunity and attack, we have a chance at victory.」
Azel said it at the very end.
To attack the instant she appears.

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nothing...」
Could it be... that Azel wants this too?

name: Helena
message: 「My intuition tells me that's the only chance we'll have to take them down.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Though statistically speaking, the odds are absurdly low.」

name: Helena
message: 「Even so.」
Helena-san and the others seemed calm, pragmatic, and ruthless.
Or maybe I--and the rest of us--are just too naive for not being able to accept it yet.

name: Helena
message: 「Where is the predicted point of appearance?」

name: Melilot
message: 「The plaza at Finis Tower. That spot lies directly beneath the singularity.」

name: Helena
message: 「And the time?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I deduce it will be right before the final event of the Holy Night Festival, the dance party. That is when spatial collapse begins.」

name: Helena
message: 「At the exact moment Re-Crea reaches its peak?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No. Slightly after. There is a time lag between Re-Crea reaching its peak and the onset of spatial collapse.」

name: Helena
message: 「Can we detect the moment they appear?」

name: Riesling
message: 「We will place the plaza under strict surveillance so we can detect the enemy the instant they manifest.」

name: Helena
message: 「What about Bylous?」

name: Melilot
message: 「If their objective is an invasion of Heaven, they shouldn't appear until just before the spatial collapse.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Furthermore, since it is inconceivable for Demons and angels to act in concert on the battlefield, I believe defeating them piecemeal is possible.」
Helena-san stood up and looked around at us.

name: Helena
message: 「And so, members of the Crusaders who make the impossible possible!」

name: Helena
message: 「Go ahead and save the world while you're enjoying the Holy Night Festival! Dismissed!」
